expect_red: annotateParamsFor: a kinematic study opens sweep mode on its run, an edge or a chain study the goto its row would post, a stack nothing

mutations.contract: A kinematic study asks the 3D pane for sweep mode on the run it folds; the one selection rule is what both carriers (the boot link and the exec commands) are fed.
mutations.note: The likeliest slip: the study's topology kept and its run dropped, which reads as a plausible launch and lands the pane in bind mode on the topology -- a goto where a sweep was asked for.
mutations.find: return run ? { topologyId: study.topology, sweep: run } : null;

mutations.contract: An edge selection carries its edge into the goto, so the pane lands on that element.
mutations.note: Dropping the edge still produces a valid goto on the study -- the pane would open somewhere sensible and wrong.
